data.title: 中野一花 · 旭高校走廊的调侃眨眼
data.description: 课间走廊微风穿过窗棂，一花轻倚着窗台护栏。她微微侧过头，眼眸弯成调皮的月牙，朝着迎面走来的少年俏皮眨眼，嘴角浮现出一抹从容戏谑却暗藏娇羞的微笑。
data.action: leaning against window, winking, smiling playfully
data.promptProse: In a bright sunlit school hallway, Nakano Ichika leans comfortably against the windowpane with a yellow cardigan tied around her waist. She gives a playful wink and a teasing smile toward the viewer, her pink hair catching the afternoon glow.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against the sunlit hallway window, she winks playfully with a subtle teasing blush.
